briefing: Markets were up today: the NASDAQ rose 1.6% and the S&P 500 rose 0.8%, and many screened stocks are showing strong momentum. We have only $345.88 in cash, which is below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so we are making no trades today. All 7 positions stay open, and their automatic profit targets and stop-losses will handle exits. NET is down about 1.6% from our cost, well above its -7% stop-loss. FLY and IONQ meet all four buy signals and are first in line once we have enough cash.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash you keep on hand so you can buy when a good opportunity comes along. Today was a good day to buy, but we had less than our $500 minimum, so we couldn't open a new position. Running nearly fully invested means good opportunities can pass you by, while holding too much cash means missing gains, so investors try to strike a balance between the two.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指預留的現金，方便在好機會出現時入市。今日雖然是入市的好時機，但可動用現金不足500美元的最低門檻，所以未能開新倉。資金接近全數投入，容易錯過好機會；但持有過多現金，又會錯失升幅，所以投資者要在兩者之間取得平衡。

market_education.summary_en: Tech and growth stocks led today's gains. The NASDAQ rose 1.6%, about twice the S&P 500's 0.8%, which shows investors were willing to take on risk. Momentum was strongest in speculative areas like quantum computing (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS), nuclear energy (OKLO, LEU) and crypto mining (RIOT), while large chip stocks such as NVDA and MU stayed below their 20-day averages. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't name a specific cause for the move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市由科技及增長股領漲，納斯達克指數上升1.6%，升幅約為標普500指數（0.8%）的兩倍，反映投資者風險胃納回升。動能最強的集中於投機性較高的板塊，包括量子運算（IONQ、RGTI、QBTS）、核能（OKLO、LEU）及加密貨幣挖礦股（RIOT）；反觀NVDA、MU等大型晶片股仍徘徊於20日均線之下。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，暫未能確定推動大市的具體因素。
